item.skyabyss.star_lamp.desc: Starlight learned at the star pool. Lights your feet and draws out what hides in shadow.
item.skyabyss.star_lamp.use: Right-click: set a star mark at your feet (30 s, two at once)
item.skyabyss.star_shard.desc: A piece of a star fallen into the new-moon valley. Three open the gate of the mesa.
item.skyabyss.moon_dust.desc: Fine pale-blue dust caked on a dust crawler's shell.
item.skyabyss.crescent_shell.desc: The crescent-shaped plate from a shell hare's back. Its rim shines silver.
item.skyabyss.shadow_thread.desc: A thread of starlight that pinned a shadow stitcher's bands together.
message.skyabyss.moon.lamp_post.need_lam: The lamp post is cold. Without a star lamp, it will not light.
message.skyabyss.moon.pool.learn: Starlight lingers on your fingertips. You learned the star lamp. (Hold it and right-click to set a star mark at your feet.)
message.skyabyss.moon.pool.again: The star pool ripples faintly. The lamp is already in your hand.
message.skyabyss.moon.shard.bridge: You took the star shard from the pedestal on the pillar.
message.skyabyss.moon.shard.mirror: The light of three mirrors gathers on the pedestal, and a star shard rises.
message.skyabyss.moon.shard.hole: At the bottom of the fallen star you pick up a shard. It is still faintly warm.
message.skyabyss.moon.shard.mirror_dark: The pedestal stays dark. The mirrors are not turned the same way.
message.skyabyss.moon.shard.hole_guarded: The shell hares guard their nest. Drive them off before you can reach the pedestal.
message.skyabyss.moon.gate_star.sealed: The star gate is closed. The traveller at the camp may know about the valley.
message.skyabyss.moon.gate_star.need_sha: The star gate hums faintly. Not enough shards yet.
message.skyabyss.moon.chasm_fall: You fell into the bottomless dark... and woke beside the camp light.
message.skyabyss.moon.lord_down: The embraced shadow comes undone, and starlight returns to the mesa.
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_valley.title: The New-Moon Valley
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_valley.summary: South of the moon landing a valley runs down. In the lee of its entrance, a camp light burns.
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_valley.done: You defeated the shadow embracer and made a promise to your past self. You will meet again at the moon's heart.
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_valley.meet.jou: A camp light burns where the valley descends south of the landing. Talk to the hooded traveller beside it.
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_valley.meet.tal: Talk to the traveller at the camp
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_valley.pool.jou: Dip your hand in the star pool at the back of the camp and learn starlight.
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_valley.shards.j: Gather three star shards fallen in the valley: the shadow bridge over the western chasm, the mirror hollow in the east, the fallen star's pit in the south.
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_valley.shards.b: Shard on the shadow bridge pillar
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_valley.shards.h: Shard in the fallen star's pit
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_valley.gate.jou: The shards are gathered. Climb to the lord's hollow through the star gate at the north foot of the mesa.
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_valley.lord.jou: Light the lamp posts of the hollow with your star lamp, draw the shadow embracer into the light and defeat it.
Return to the traveller at the camp.
Talk to the traveller at the camp
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_moon_past1.ch6_v:
...You came. You followed the camp light, didn't you?
When I first came here, I followed the same light. ...I never knew who had lit it.
Sit. On the moon, hurrying won't bring the dawn.
Who are you?
What is this valley?

Any name I could give is under the dust now.
What I remember is walking this valley again and again. And stopping, again and again, on top of that mesa.

A lord of shadow waits on the mesa. In the dark, no blade gets through.
Dip your hand in the star pool at the back. Learn starlight, and you can draw the shadow out.
Go to the star pool

The star pool is the purple bowl at the back of the camp.
Dip your hand, and a star lamp stays with you. Light your feet with it.
Understood
Three star shards fell in this valley. With all three, the mesa gate opens.
Which do you want to hear about?
The shadow bridge
The mirror hollow
The fallen star's pit
I'm going

Over the western chasm there's a bridge that exists only in the dark. Light it and it's gone.
The shard is on the pillar in the middle. ...Set your lamp once you're across. The stitchers wait on the bridge.

In the white hollow to the east stand three mirror stones.
Turn all three to face the middle, and starlight gathers on the pedestal. ...They are always a little off.

A star fell into the southern pit. Shell hares nest there.
They leap high and come down on you. When a ring of shadow appears at your feet, step out of it. Drive off the nest and you can reach the pedestal at the bottom.

You have all three. At the north foot of the mesa is the star gate.
Through it lies the lord's hollow, with six lamp posts. ...Light them with your lamp and draw the shadow into them.
I'm going
The embracer never lets go of the shadow it holds. While it stays in the dark, no blade gets through.

Draw it into the light and it freezes for a moment. Strike then.
...Last time, I spent all my light here. Don't hurry your lamps.
Understood
...You beat it. I saw the shadow on the mesa come undone.

I remembered something. On the last night, the moon fell.
I couldn't stop it. Time wound back, and I was standing at the valley's mouth again. ...I've stopped counting how many times.

At the moon's heart there is a core that turns time back. Let's meet there.
This time, we stop it together. ...I'll leave this light with you.
I promise
On the moon, hurrying won't bring the dawn. ...Rest a while.
I'll be back
chapter.skyabyss.aftermath.chapter3: The valley's shadow has come undone. The moon's center is still far.
message.skyabyss.moon_end.todo: The journey on the moon ends here in this version. The Waxing Cliffs and beyond follow in the next.
